name: Camping Aufenfeld
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Aufenfeld is located in Aschau im Zillertal in Tirol and is open all year round. The surrounding area is characterized by the Zillertaler Bergwelt. In winter, guests can reach the ski areas Zillertal Arena and Hochzillertal. In summer, hiking trails and mountain bike trails are available. The facilities include sanitary facilities, a bread roll service and a common room. On the site, guests can set up motorhomes, caravans and tents. Dogs are allowed. The campsite offers a base for a holiday in the natural surroundings of the Zillertal.
